verification.validation: PageMeta: a page's own controls at the start of AppShell's page bar, before its PageInfo, with an optional menu for the phone bar's “…” in the mobile layout. Frontend vitest for the shell (page-meta and the other shell tests, desktop and mobile layouts), typecheck and vite build against UI 0.25.10, sdk-version and executor manifest checks, and an internal-content scan of the packed npm tarballs. No browser check, full gate, target matrix, executor rebuild, Rust build, crate publication or NAS acceptance.

changes: PageMeta puts a page's own controls, such as a volume or device picker, at the start of AppShell's page bar (the title line with header: true), before the page's PageInfo and the App's #meta, and removes them with the page. Existing PageInfo and PageActions placement is unchanged.

In the mobile layout a PageMeta with a menu shows those DropdownMenuEntry items first in the phone bar's “…” in place of its controls and emits select; without a menu the controls stay in the page bar.
Native v1 adds the close page message and the bridge's optional features list (from #205).
